summary: Open authenticated raw PEEK directly and keep browser PEEK capabilities in memory, with zero durable PEEK claims

replay.detail: Existing durable claims remain readable; PEEK issue/consume no longer append attachment or consumption claims. ATTACH claims are unchanged.

schema.detail: No database migration or schema change.

compatibility.detail: New Rust raw_terminal_peek returns the existing controlled stream on one authenticated upgrade. Browser PEEK keeps its capability API but capabilities are daemon-local, single-use and invalid after restart; reacquire outstanding PEEK capabilities on upgrade. ATTACH is unchanged. Per-open authorization and revocable leases remain required.

downtime.detail: Only normal daemon restart; active observation streams reconnect.

manual.detail: No configuration changes. Native clients can adopt raw_terminal_peek after upgrading their SDK.

recovery.detail: PEEK who-looked-when is observability data, not durable store audit. No database recovery changes.
